say:0:1623237001:0.text: I wonder how everything is going in the forest.
say:0:1623237001:0.source_cn: 不知道森林那边怎么样了，去找赫普聊聊。
say:0:1623237001:0.male: I wonder how everything is going in the forest.
say:0:1623237001:0.female: I wonder how everything is going in the forest.

say:1:1623238001:1.text: Remember that student I mentioned, the one researching substitutes for magical materials? His thesis just got rejected.
say:1:1623238001:1.source_cn: 还记得我跟你说过那个研究魔法材料替代品的学生吗？他的论...
say:1:1623238001:1.male: Remember that student I mentioned, the one researching substitutes for magical materials? His thesis just got rejected.
say:1:1623238001:1.female: Remember that student I mentioned, the one researching substitutes for magical materials? His thesis just got rejected.

say:2:1623238002:1.text: He's on the right track, and the experiment works... sometimes. It's not stable enough for practical application yet.
say:2:1623238002:1.source_cn: 方向没错，实验也偶尔能成，只是稳定性不足，达不到真正能...
say:2:1623238002:1.male: He's on the right track, and the experiment works... sometimes. It's not stable enough for practical application yet.
say:2:1623238002:1.female: He's on the right track, and the experiment works... sometimes. It's not stable enough for practical application yet.

say:3:1623238003:1.text: Still, the idea and the drive he showed in pursuing it are respectable.
say:3:1623238003:1.source_cn: 不过嘛，他的想法和他为了实现想法所表现出的行动力，这点...
say:3:1623238003:1.male: Still, the idea and the drive he showed in pursuing it are respectable.
say:3:1623238003:1.female: Still, the idea and the drive he showed in pursuing it are respectable.

say:4:1623238004:1.text: It's like hunting. Movement matters more than wishful thinking.
say:4:1623238004:1.source_cn: 就像捕猎一样，行动才是最重要的。
say:4:1623238004:1.male: It's like hunting. Movement matters more than wishful thinking.
say:4:1623238004:1.female: It's like hunting. Movement matters more than wishful thinking.

say:5:1623238005:1.text: Can I ask you a favor, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? Could you help me review some papers, or go check on those two little troublemakers in the woods?
say:5:1623238005:1.male: Can I ask you a favor, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? Could you help me review some papers, or go check on those two little troublemakers in the woods?
say:5:1623238005:1.female: Can I ask you a favor, <style="stress"><player_name></style>? Could you help me review some papers, or go check on those two little troublemakers in the woods?

say:6:1623238006:1.source_cn: 你瞧，桌子上那堆变形术论文……
say:6:1623238006:1.male: See that pile of transfiguration papers on my desk...?
say:6:1623238006:1.female: See that pile of transfiguration papers on my desk...?

choice_prompt:7:1623238006.female: See that pile of transfiguration papers on my desk...?

say:8:1623238007:1.text: Well, I get it. Every time I read student papers, I start asking myself if I should change my job.
say:8:1623238007:1.source_cn: 唉，我很理解。每次批改学生论文，我总会怀疑我自己的教学水平。
say:8:1623238007:1.male: Well, I get it. Every time I read student papers, I start asking myself if I should change my job.
say:8:1623238007:1.female: Well, I get it. Every time I read student papers, I start asking myself if I should change my job.

say:9:1623238008:1.text: Alright. I'm curious what's new those two will cook up this time... Haha. Just kidding.
say:9:1623238008:1.source_cn: 好吧，就麻烦你去森林看看吧。我挺想知道那两个小家伙又会...
say:9:1623238008:1.male: Alright. I'm curious what's new those two will cook up this time... Haha. Just kidding.
say:9:1623238008:1.female: Alright. I'm curious what's new those two will cook up this time... Haha. Just kidding.

say:10:1623238009:1.text: Whatever happens, try not to interfere unless the forest is harmed.
say:10:1623238009:1.source_cn: 无论他们碰到了什么事，只要不打破本有的生态平衡，就顺其...
say:10:1623238009:1.male: Whatever happens, try not to interfere unless the forest is harmed.
say:10:1623238009:1.female: Whatever happens, try not to interfere unless the forest is harmed.

choice:7:1:2.source_cn: 我还是帮你跑一趟森林吧

say:0:1623240001:1.text: As you approach, Candel is hopping beside the shrubs, letting out sharp little chirps with total commitment. Under a tree, Sweep twists stiffly, trying its best to imitate a squirrel looking around.
say:0:1623240001:1.source_cn: 你走近时，看到坎德尔正在灌木丛边卖力地跳跃，发出尖锐的...
say:0:1623240001:1.male: As you approach, Candel is hopping beside the shrubs, letting out sharp little chirps with total commitment. Under a tree, Sweep twists stiffly, trying its best to imitate a squirrel looking around.
say:0:1623240001:1.female: As you approach, Candel is hopping beside the shrubs, letting out sharp little chirps with total commitment. Under a tree, Sweep twists stiffly, trying its best to imitate a squirrel looking around.

say:2:1623240002:0.text: You came just in time, Magister! We've made a new plan!
say:2:1623240002:0.source_cn: 魔法师大人，你来得正好！我们做了一个新的决定！
say:2:1623240002:0.male: You came just in time, Magister! We've made a new plan!
say:2:1623240002:0.female: You came just in time, Magister! We've made a new plan!

say:3:1623240003:0.text: If we can't help as we are... why don't we just become animals?
say:3:1623240003:0.source_cn: 既然帮不上忙，那我们直接成为动物不就行了？
say:3:1623240003:0.male: If we can't help as we are... why don't we just become animals?
say:3:1623240003:0.female: If we can't help as we are... why don't we just become animals?

say:4:1623240004:1.text: *Tweet* *Chirp* Look! Do I sound like the Songbird? I studied him for days!
say:4:1623240004:1.source_cn: 唧唧！啾——你看我学爱唱歌的鸟学得像不像？我可观察了好几天！
say:4:1623240004:1.male: *Tweet* *Chirp* Look! Do I sound like the Songbird? I studied him for days!
say:4:1623240004:1.female: *Tweet* *Chirp* Look! Do I sound like the Songbird? I studied him for days!

say:5:1623240005:1.text: B-But being a squirrel is really hard... They turn their heads so fast...
say:5:1623240005:1.source_cn: 可、可是当松鼠真的好难……他们转头的动作太灵活了……
say:5:1623240005:1.male: B-But being a squirrel is really hard... They turn their heads so fast...
say:5:1623240005:1.female: B-But being a squirrel is really hard... They turn their heads so fast...

choice_prompt:6:1623240005.text: B-But being a squirrel is really hard... They turn their heads so fast...
choice_prompt:6:1623240005.source_cn: 可、可是当松鼠真的好难……他们转头的动作太灵活了……
choice_prompt:6:1623240005.male: B-But being a squirrel is really hard... They turn their heads so fast...
choice_prompt:6:1623240005.female: B-But being a squirrel is really hard... They turn their heads so fast...

say:8:1623240006:0.text: A few animals peek out from behind the tree, expressions sour and unamused.
say:8:1623240006:0.source_cn: 几只动物从树后探出头来，面露不满。

say:10:1623240007:0.text: Shh! You're disturbing my babies. We're trying to sleep!
say:10:1623240007:0.source_cn: 太吵了！完全打扰到我和孩子们休息了！

say:11:1623240008:0.text: And for the record, my song is meant to flow sweetly. Not... barked out like that.
say:11:1623240008:0.source_cn: 而且我的叫声是婉转的，不是这样生硬的……

say:12:1623240011:1.text: Let's be real. You're not animals. Staying here just means more trouble for everyone.
say:12:1623240011:1.source_cn: 话说回来，你们根本就不是动物，在这里就只能给大家添乱。

say:13:1623240012:1.text: Good feathers! Isn't that a little... too harsh?
say:13:1623240012:1.source_cn: 唧，你这样说会不会太直接了……

say:14:1623240013:1.text: Oh, come on. Don't pretend it's new.

say:15:1623240014:1.text: Well, okay... Everyone feels that way.
say:15:1623240014:1.source_cn: 好吧……大家其实都是这样想的。

say:16:1623240015:0.text: Hmph. If nobody wants to say it, then I will. You aren't animals and you don't belong here. You'll only make things harder for the whole forest!
say:16:1623240015:0.source_cn: 哼，既然都不愿意出头，那就我来说！你们根本不是动物，没...

say:18:1623240016:1.text: After they finish, the animals storm off, puffed up.
say:18:1623240016:1.source_cn: 动物们说完后，气鼓鼓地离开了。

say:20:1623240017:0.text: Tsk. So what if we're not animals? As if we care!
say:20:1623240017:0.source_cn: ……哼，不是动物又怎样？谁……谁稀罕做动物！

say:21:1623240018:1.text: Maybe... we were never meant to be here.
say:21:1623240018:1.source_cn: 也许……这里本来就不适合我们。

say:22:1623240019:1.text: What?! Why is it always us bending for everyone else? Can't you think just once about how we want to live?
say:22:1623240019:1.source_cn: 不适合？为什么每次都是我们去适应别人？你就不能想想我们...

say:23:1623240020:1.text: But... we were created to serve others in the first place.
say:23:1623240020:1.source_cn: 可我们被创造出来，不就是为了服务他人吗？

say:24:1623240021:1.text: So that means people can toss us aside whenever they feel like it? If that's the deal, I'd rather never have been made at all! I'm done!
say:24:1623240021:1.source_cn: 那我们就该被随意嫌弃吗？要是这样，我宁愿从来没被造出来...

say:25:1623240022:1.text: "Don't belong here"? Just because we're magical creations? We really tried—we've been learning from them!
say:25:1623240022:1.source_cn: 凭什么说我们不能融入森林？就因为我们生来是魔法造物？我...

say:26:1623240023:1.text: You want to step in, then Hepler's words catch you: Don't interfere too much.
say:26:1623240023:1.source_cn: 你想上前安抚一下坎德尔，但你想起了赫普的话——不要过度干涉。
say:26:1623240023:1.male: You want to step in, then Hepler's words catch you: Don't interfere too much.
say:26:1623240023:1.female: You want to step in, then Hepler's words catch you: Don't interfere too much.

say:28:1623240025:1.text: Candel notices his voice rising and forces himself to settle, like a human taking a deep breath.
say:28:1623240025:1.source_cn: 坎德尔意识到自己的情绪激动，似乎在有意舒缓，像是人类的...

say:30:1623240027:1.text: I know. It really hurts hearing that from them...
say:30:1623240027:1.source_cn: 我明白……其实，他们说这样的话……我心里特别不好受。

choice_prompt:31:1623240027.text: I know. It really hurts hearing that from them...
choice_prompt:31:1623240027.source_cn: 我明白……其实，他们说这样的话……我心里特别不好受。

say:32:1623240028:1.text: B-Because we were made different! We are magical creations who can talk!
say:32:1623240028:1.source_cn: 我们……因为我们和所有的魔法造物都不一样，我们在被造出...

say:33:1623240030:1.text: Because we're too brilliant, that's why! Other magical creations envy us. Apparently even the animals do!
say:33:1623240030:1.source_cn: 但正因为我们太优秀了，所以那些魔法造物都嫉妒我们，连动...

say:34:1623240031:1.text: Come on, Sweep. We're leaving! Unique creations like us will certainly find our place in the world and shine bright!
say:34:1623240031:1.source_cn: 我们走，斯威普。我们离开这里！我们这样优秀的魔法造物，...

say:36:1623240033:1.text: Then, something rustles through the brush nearby.
say:36:1623240033:1.source_cn: 此时不远处传来一阵杂乱的声音，像是什么在草丛里移动。

say:37:1623240034:0.text: What was that? Sweep, we should check it out.
say:37:1623240034:0.source_cn: 那是什么？斯威普，我们得过去看看。

choice:31:0:1.text: Why did you leave the Lyceum?
choice:31:0:1.source_cn: 你们究竟为什么离开莱希拉姆？
choice:31:0:1.male: Why did you leave the Lyceum?
choice:31:0:1.female: Why did you leave the Lyceum?

say:39:1623240029:1.text: Well, nobody said only animals get to live here. The forest is for all of us.
say:39:1623240029:1.source_cn: 因为……没人规定只有动物才能留在森林啊，森林是属于我们...

choice:31:1:2.source_cn: 你们为何一定要留在森林？

choice:6:0:1.text: That... is not a good idea.
choice:6:0:1.male: That... is not a good idea.
choice:6:0:1.female: That... is not a good idea.

say:41:1623240009:1.text: A few animals peek out from behind the tree, looking helpless.
say:41:1623240009:1.source_cn: 几只动物从树后探出头来，面露无奈。

say:43:1623240010:0.text: It's been all day! We can't get a moment of peace!
say:43:1623240010:0.source_cn: 可是他们从早叫到晚，已经严重打扰大家休息了！
say:43:1623240010:0.male: It's been all day! We can't get a moment of peace!
say:43:1623240010:0.female: It's been all day! We can't get a moment of peace!

say:0:1623241001:0.text: Something on the left. Let's go!
say:0:1623241001:0.source_cn: 左边有什么声音，过去看看！

say:1:1623241002:0.text: Easy. Let's keep our distance and get eyes on it first.
say:1:1623241002:0.source_cn: 别急，先从远处眺望一下情况。
say:1:1623241002:0.male: Easy. Let's keep our distance and get eyes on it first.
say:1:1623241002:0.female: Easy. Let's keep our distance and get eyes on it first.

say:0:1623242001:0.text: The two "travelers" from earlier. Looking suspicious. Let's go.
say:0:1623242001:0.source_cn: 是那两个人……他们鬼鬼祟祟的……嗯，我们过去看看。
say:0:1623242001:0.male: The two "travelers" from earlier. Looking suspicious. Let's go.
say:0:1623242001:0.female: The two "travelers" from earlier. Looking suspicious. Let's go.

say:1:1623243002:0.text: One more stupid question, and I'll leave you here!
say:1:1623243002:0.source_cn: 别再问愚蠢的问题了！现在不是吃的时候！

say:2:1623244001:1.text: So the rumors were true that the woods near the Serene Lyceum are a goldmine, packed with "valuable stock."
say:2:1623244001:1.source_cn: 不愧是莱希拉姆附近的森林，这简直就是个宝库，“值钱的动...

say:3:1623244002:1.text: Yeah! Bag a couple, grind 'em into materials, and the underground market will pay a fortune!
say:3:1623244002:1.source_cn: 是啊！随便抓几只做成魔法材料，黑市上能卖出天价！

say:4:1623244003:1.text: Then I can eat like a king every day!
say:4:1623244003:1.source_cn: 到时候我每天都可以吃大餐了！

say:0:1623244101:1.text: One of them pulls a strange device from his pack. An eerie, magical pulse crawls off it.
say:0:1623244101:1.source_cn: 其中一个人从背包里取出一个造型奇特的装置，隐约散发着诡...

say:3:1623244202:1.text: You fool. This isn't easy bunny-snatching. This is my trap, with a built-in charm effect. Watch and learn.
say:3:1623244202:1.source_cn: 你这笨蛋，抓魔法生物能跟抓兔子一样吗？这当然是我搞的陷...

say:6:1623244205:1.text: Your trap! I told you to bring one before we left!
say:6:1623244205:1.source_cn: 陷阱啊！出门前我不是让你准备吗？！

say:0:1623244301:1.text: He produces an ordinary pinecone, with no magic trace at all.
say:0:1623244301:1.source_cn: 他掏出一颗普通的松塔，你感受不到任何魔法痕迹。
say:0:1623244301:1.male: He produces an ordinary pinecone, with no magic trace at all.
say:0:1623244301:1.female: He produces an ordinary pinecone, with no magic trace at all.

say:2:1623244401:1.text: Pinecone? You think we're on a picnic?
say:2:1623244401:1.source_cn: 松塔？！你当是来野餐的吗？！

say:3:1623244402:1.text: Don't underestimate it! It's poisoned... Heh. One small sniff and the little creatures will be foaming at the mouth.
say:3:1623244402:1.source_cn: 你别小看它！这是被下过毒的松塔……嘿嘿，别说吃了，只要...

say:0:1623244501:1.text: He gives it a little shake. A strange powder seeps between the cone scales, making you hold your breath.
say:0:1623244501:1.source_cn: 他捏着松塔轻轻一晃，松鳞间渗出一丝奇怪的粉末，让人不自...

say:2:1623244601:1.text: Now that's more like it. It's the real deal tonight. Took us long enough to find this place, and we're making it count.
say:2:1623244601:1.source_cn: 行了，这才像话。今晚我们有大生意——既然好不容易找到这...

say:3:1623244602:1.text: Hehehe... Little forest critters, come to me. I love the look they get when they realize they can't escape.
say:3:1623244602:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿嘿——森林的小家伙，我最喜欢他们绝望挣扎的样子了。

say:1:1623245001:1.text: What?! Th-They're going to turn animals into magical materials?
say:1:1623245001:1.source_cn: 怎么回事！他们……他们要把动物做成魔法材料？

choice_prompt:2:1623245001.text: What?! Th-They're going to turn animals into magical materials?
choice_prompt:2:1623245001.source_cn: 怎么回事！他们……他们要把动物做成魔法材料？

say:3:1623245002:1.text: Poachers... So they steal animals away... just for profit?
say:3:1623245002:1.source_cn: 非法商人……也就是说，这些人为了自己的利益，随便掠走小...

say:4:1623245003:1.text: Fine, maybe the animals don't get us. Maybe they don't get magic. But these black-market poachers? Over my bristles!
say:4:1623245003:1.source_cn: 哼，虽然那些动物们不分是非、不懂魔法、更不理解我们的良...

say:5:1623245004:1.text: Sweep, we have to do something! We have to... But how...
say:5:1623245004:1.source_cn: 斯威普，我们得做点什么，一定要做点什么……我们能做什么...

say:8:1623245006:0.text: Candel pulls Sweep in and blurts out his plan in a single breath.
say:8:1623245006:0.source_cn: 坎德尔一把拉住斯威普，三句并做一句，快速向他说明自己的计划。

say:9:1623245007:0.text: Then they dash out before you can stop them. You stay close, watching, ready to jump in if it goes sideways.
say:9:1623245007:0.source_cn: 然后他们一下子冲了出去，连你都来不及阻止。你只好在附近...
say:9:1623245007:0.male: Then they dash out before you can stop them. You stay close, watching, ready to jump in if it goes sideways.
say:9:1623245007:0.female: Then they dash out before you can stop them. You stay close, watching, ready to jump in if it goes sideways.

say:2:1623248001:1.text: I can't believe you took those two down so fast. That's awesome!
say:2:1623248001:1.source_cn: 没想到那两个坏蛋就这么被你解决了，真厉害啊！
say:2:1623248001:1.male: I can't believe you took those two down so fast. That's awesome!
say:2:1623248001:1.female: I can't believe you took those two down so fast. That's awesome!

say:3:1623248002:1.text: Candel's bristles are singed, Sweep's metal is scuffed. Both are carrying new injuries from the fight with the poachers.
say:3:1623248002:1.source_cn: 你发现坎德尔与斯威普身上都有不同程度的伤，应该是刚才与...
say:3:1623248002:1.male: Candel's bristles are singed, Sweep's metal is scuffed. Both are carrying new injuries from the fight with the poachers.
say:3:1623248002:1.female: Candel's bristles are singed, Sweep's metal is scuffed. Both are carrying new injuries from the fight with the poachers.

choice_prompt:4:1623248002.text: Candel's bristles are singed, Sweep's metal is scuffed. Both are carrying new injuries from the fight with the poachers.
choice_prompt:4:1623248002.source_cn: 你发现坎德尔与斯威普身上都有不同程度的伤，应该是刚才与偷猎者战斗时造成的。
choice_prompt:4:1623248002.male: Candel's bristles are singed, Sweep's metal is scuffed. Both are carrying new injuries from the fight with the poachers.
choice_prompt:4:1623248002.female: Candel's bristles are singed, Sweep's metal is scuffed. Both are carrying new injuries from the fight with the poachers.

say:5:1623248003:0.text: Just some scratches. Nothing serious. We're great magical creations, after all! Right, Sweep?
say:5:1623248003:0.source_cn: 这点小伤不碍事……我们自己能处理的，我们可是伟大的魔法...
say:5:1623248003:0.male: Just some scratches. Nothing serious. We're great magical creations, after all! Right, Sweep?
say:5:1623248003:0.female: Just some scratches. Nothing serious. We're great magical creations, after all! Right, Sweep?

say:6:1623248004:0.text: Yeah, it's not a big deal! As long as the woods are safe!
say:6:1623248004:0.male: Yeah, it's not a big deal! As long as the woods are safe!
say:6:1623248004:0.female: Yeah, it's not a big deal! As long as the woods are safe!

say:7:1623248005:1.text: But... the animals... they might think we're causing trouble again.
say:7:1623248005:1.source_cn: 但是……那些动物们……可能会觉得我们又是在捣乱吧。
say:7:1623248005:1.male: But... the animals... they might think we're causing trouble again.
say:7:1623248005:1.female: But... the animals... they might think we're causing trouble again.
